description: This file contains the implementation of a platform-dependent utility function for the Bwrm (Broadway Web Resource Manager), specifically the creation of a Cooked Page object, including licensing headers, comments explaining the function, and the function implementation itself.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE BwrmCreateCookedPage(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Creates a new Bwrm Cooked Page object, taking container, owner, and reserved context handles as arguments and returning a handle to the created object.
